assets.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Create one finished isolated Crown capital building sprite for an antique dark-fantasy civilization regional map. A complete compact authoritarian imperial citadel: squat imposing ash-grey stone keep, stepped crown-like crenellations, one tall central fortified tower, worn vermilion pennants, very restrained oxidized teal copper roof details. Blackened ossuary masonry incorporates rows of tiny skull niches and bone buttresses into the foundations; architecture feels ancient, oppressive, decaying and still inhabited. No people or faces. Three-quarter overhead isometric camera, light from upper left, full building centered, complete silhouette with generous transparent margins all sides, no cropping. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the building and its very small irregular earth footing; no colored background, no haze, no detached cast shadow. Match a 1990s illustrated strategy-map building kit: deliberate hard-edged pixel clusters, selective engraving and dithering, muted ochre stone highlights and charcoal shadows, restrained earthy color range, materials visible, not smooth photoreal render or modern vector icon. Strong simple roof/tower silhouette readable at 40 to 60 screen pixels wide. Keep enough midtone stone and red fabric to read against a busy dark forest or mountain map. Object dominates central 65 percent of square canvas. No scenery, surrounding landscape, text, labels, numbers, frame, border, watermark or user interface.
